summary: Frontend-only validation completed for preview/render and voice-note regression scope. Web preview loads reliably with sign-in screen and build marker visible, but invalid chat route still triggers repeated runtime loop errors and authenticated chat-surface flow remains unverified due external Google/OIDC dependency in automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign-in click behavior is inconsistent in browser automation: one run opened Hercules sign-in in a new page, other runs stayed on root with no visible in-app transition, blocking deterministic auth automation.

integration_issues.issue: UI falls back to chat-unavailable-state but console floods with repeated 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors, indicating unresolved render/update loop.

Could not complete end-to-end login using provided Google-based account in automation (no password in repo; third-party interactive OAuth), so authenticated chat navigation and voice-note playback/send stability under signed-in state remains unverified.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated update-depth runtime errors persist on invalid conversation route despite fallback UI.
expo-av deprecation warning appears in console/logs; voice-note path still compiles but migration planning is needed before SDK 54.

action_items: Fix the render/update loop causing repeated 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors on invalid chat route; likely around useSafeConvexQuery refetch dependency churn.
Stabilize web auth handoff from sign-in-btn (deterministic popup/redirect signaling and testable auth state feedback).
After auth automation path is stable, retest authenticated route to chat list/conversation and voice-note interaction under signed-in state.
Add /app/auth_testing.md playbook (or /app/auth-testing.md) for future auth-gated test consistency; both files are currently missing.
critical_code_review_comments: app/chat/[conversationId].tsx remains oversized (>1000 lines), reducing maintainability and making runtime regression root-cause analysis harder.
app/chat/[conversationId].tsx still contains unused local MessageBubble implementation while MediaBubble is rendered, indicating DRY violation and dead-code risk.

useSafeConvexQuery refetch effect depends on a callback that can be recreated frequently (queryRef/stableArgs identity churn), which aligns with observed update-depth loop errors under failing queries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md first (available). /app/auth_testing.md and /app/auth-testing.md are missing. Root sign-in screen is stable with version marker v2.0.12 visible. Invalid chat route still produces heavy update-depth console errors. Auth flow is third-party Google/OIDC and was not fully automatable here.
rca_of_issue: Repro for loop: open /chat/test-conversation, wait ~4s. UI shows chat-unavailable-state, but console repeatedly emits 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Likely cause: query failure path repeatedly retriggers state updates/refetch in custom query hook lifecycle. Repro for auth gating: click sign-in-btn from root; in some runs a new Hercules auth page appears in browser context, in others no detectable page transition, preventing deterministic automated login and downstream chat-route verification.
